pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal - airy whisper + soft hum]
(soft pulsing pads, distant water-drop pluck, wide reverb, dreamy moonlit atmosphere)

Moonlight… seeps through the window…
Your scent… still lives here…

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(behind-the-beat, breathy, locked to kick/snare)

Moonlight slips through the window frame
Your scent still lingers in my room
Too heavy to even open the door
Your tears press down on my heart

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(sub bass follows kick, minimal pads)

Your love is moonlight fallen in the well
Quietly removing shadows while I sleep
Sending last breaths on the wind
Until even the moonlight disappears

[Hook]
[Female Vocal - phonetic loop]
(slight silence before, then full groove impact)

I’ll let you go… slowly now
Like sand… slipping through my hands
Quietly… without too much pain
I’ll disappear… like gentle rain

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(repeat hook with layered airy ad-libs)

I’ll let you go… slowly now
Like sand… slipping through my hands
When you bloom again in spring
I hope my scent won’t remain

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(more textured rasp, close mic)

Your season felt too heavy for me
So I became winter and walked away
Falling quietly like autumn leaves
I’ll wait for spring from far away

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(pads pulse stronger)

I erased your name with my tears
I hope your sky has no clouds at all
This goodbye is my last gift to you
How much I loved you, only I knew

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(stronger groove, add light vocal fry)

I’ll let you go… slowly now
Like sand… slipping through my hands
When you bloom again in spring
I hope my scent won’t remain

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(full layers, humming in background)

I’ll let you go… slowly now
Like sand… slipping through my hands
When you bloom again in spring
I hope my scent won’t remain

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal - half-whisper]
(everything drops to sub bass + soft pads)

It was a goodbye… just for you…
So you could have your own spring…

[Rap]
[Female Vocal - low, breathy, close]
(exact drum interlock, behind snare)

Days I lied saying my pain was better
So you would hurt a little less
That was my love, my silent prayer
Now I let go with no regret
Bloom without me, shine so bright
I’ll fade into the quiet night
Yeah… this was love…

[Break]
[Instrumental + Humming]
(only water-drop pluck + pulsing pads, airy hums)

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(max layers, rich reverb)

I’ll let you go… this is my gift
Bloom in your spring… live without rift
Even if it breaks me… I’ll be fine
This quiet love… was only mine

[Outro]
[Female Vocal - fading]
(heavy reverb, last syllable fry, slow fade)

Bloom for me… without me…
(soft humming till end)
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
